notes: Reusable destination-day modules for the Air India CWC 2027 and Taj Holidays verticals. Plans 1-5 are ordered module ID lists; stays beyond five nights append any unused modules (e.g. Cape Town's Robben Island day) before repeating the leisure module.

modules.title: Namaste, Delhi
modules.summary: Land in the capital and settle in with an evening at India Gate and a stroll around Connaught Place before your onward Air India connection.
modules.imageAlt: India Gate illuminated at dusk in New Delhi

modules.title: Old Delhi heritage
modules.summary: Explore the Mughal capital — Red Fort ramparts, Jama Masjid, and a cycle-rickshaw ride through the spice lanes and street food of Chandni Chowk.
modules.imageAlt: Red Fort and the lanes of Chandni Chowk, Old Delhi

modules.title: Imperial New Delhi
modules.summary: Humayun's Tomb, the Qutub Minar complex, and a drive past Rashtrapati Bhavan and Rajpath — the ceremonial heart of the capital.
modules.imageAlt: Humayun's Tomb gardens in New Delhi

modules.title: Delhi at leisure
modules.summary: A clearly marked free day — boutique shopping at Khan Market or Dilli Haat, or simply rest before the next leg of your journey.
modules.imageAlt: India Gate illuminated at dusk in New Delhi

modules.title: Onward connection
modules.summary: A relaxed half-day before your Air India connecting flight, with time for the Lotus Temple or Akshardham if your schedule allows.
modules.imageAlt: India Gate illuminated at dusk in New Delhi

modules.title: Welcome to Mumbai
modules.summary: Arrive on the Arabian Sea — a sunset walk along Marine Drive and your first view of the Gateway of India lit up over the harbour.
modules.imageAlt: Gateway of India monument in Mumbai at dusk

modules.title: Colonial Mumbai & Elephanta
modules.summary: Gateway of India, the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, and a ferry across the harbour to the rock-cut Elephanta Caves.
modules.imageAlt: Marine Drive promenade in Mumbai

modules.title: Sea Link & bazaars
modules.summary: A drive across the Bandra-Worli Sea Link, then browse Crawford Market and the Colaba Causeway for souvenirs and street food.
modules.imageAlt: Bandra-Worli Sea Link bridge in Mumbai

modules.title: Mumbai at leisure
modules.summary: A clearly marked free day in the city — rest, optional shopping, or a Bollywood studio visit rather than a scheduled touring circuit.
modules.imageAlt: Gateway of India monument in Mumbai at dusk

modules.title: Onward connection
modules.summary: A relaxed half-day ahead of your Air India connecting flight, with time for a last coastal walk near the Gateway of India.
modules.imageAlt: Gateway of India monument in Mumbai at dusk

modules.title: Touch down in Johannesburg
modules.summary: Land in Gauteng and settle in with an evening at Nelson Mandela Square in Sandton — restaurants, city lights, and first World Cup buzz.
modules.imageAlt: Johannesburg city skyline at dusk

modules.title: Soweto & Apartheid Museum
modules.summary: A moving day through the Apartheid Museum, then Soweto's Vilakazi Street — the only street to have housed two Nobel laureates — and the Hector Pieterson Memorial.
modules.imageAlt: Vilakazi Street in Soweto, Johannesburg

modules.title: Cradle of Humankind
modules.summary: A day trip to the Cradle of Humankind UNESCO World Heritage Site — Sterkfontein Caves and the Maropeng visitor centre tracing 3.5 million years of human origins.
modules.imageAlt: Sterkfontein Caves at the Cradle of Humankind

modules.title: Match day at the Wanderers
modules.summary: Cricket World Cup 2027 fixture day at The Wanderers Stadium — known to every touring team as 'The Bullring' for its raucous atmosphere.
modules.imageAlt: The Wanderers Stadium, Johannesburg, on match day

modules.title: Johannesburg at leisure
modules.summary: A free day for Sandton shopping, a spa afternoon, or an optional visit to Gold Reef City theme park.
modules.imageAlt: Johannesburg city skyline at dusk

modules.title: Arrive in Cape Town
modules.summary: Land beneath Table Mountain and take an evening stroll around the V&A Waterfront — harbour lights, street performers, and your first Cape sunset.
modules.imageAlt: Table Mountain over Cape Town at sunset

modules.title: Table Mountain & the City Bowl
modules.summary: Cable car to the top of Table Mountain for panoramic views, then explore the colourful houses of Bo-Kaap and the Company's Garden.
modules.imageAlt: Table Mountain over Cape Town at sunset

modules.title: Cape Point & penguins
modules.summary: A full day down the Cape Peninsula via Chapman's Peak Drive to Cape Point and the Cape of Good Hope, with African penguins at Boulders Beach.
modules.imageAlt: Cape Point and the Cape of Good Hope

modules.title: Cape Town at leisure
modules.summary: A free day at the V&A Waterfront — harbour cruise, shopping, or an optional trip into the Stellenbosch and Franschhoek Winelands.
modules.imageAlt: V&A Waterfront harbour in Cape Town

modules.title: Match day at Newlands
modules.summary: Cricket World Cup 2027 fixture day at Newlands Cricket Ground, beneath Devil's Peak — one of the most scenic Test grounds in the world.
modules.imageAlt: Newlands Cricket Ground, Cape Town, on match day

modules.title: Robben Island
modules.summary: A ferry crossing to Robben Island, where Nelson Mandela was imprisoned for 18 years — a powerful, guided history of South Africa's road to democracy.
modules.imageAlt: Robben Island viewed from Table Bay

modules.title: Arrive in Durban
modules.summary: Settle in on the subtropical Indian Ocean coast with a welcome walk along the Golden Mile promenade.
modules.imageAlt: Golden Mile beachfront promenade in Durban

modules.title: uShaka & the Golden Mile
modules.summary: uShaka Marine World, a ride on the Moses Mabhida Stadium SkyCar, and an afternoon on the Golden Mile's surf beaches.
modules.imageAlt: uShaka Marine World in Durban

modules.title: Durban's Indian quarter
modules.summary: Victoria Street Market and the Grey Street precinct — home to the largest Indian community outside India, with spice traders, the Juma Masjid, and Bunny Chow lunch.
modules.imageAlt: Victoria Street Market in Durban

modules.title: Match day at Kingsmead
modules.summary: Cricket World Cup 2027 fixture day at Kingsmead — one of the oldest and most atmospheric grounds in world cricket.
modules.imageAlt: Kingsmead Stadium, Durban, on match day

modules.title: Durban at leisure
modules.summary: A free beach day on the Golden Mile, with time for a spa treatment or a stroll through the Botanic Gardens.
modules.imageAlt: Golden Mile beachfront promenade in Durban

modules.title: Arrive in Centurion
modules.summary: A short road transfer from OR Tambo to Centurion, with an easy welcome walk beside Centurion Lake.
modules.imageAlt: Centurion Lake in Gauteng, South Africa

modules.title: Pretoria day trip
modules.summary: The Union Buildings and their terraced gardens, the Voortrekker Monument, and Church Square in South Africa's administrative capital.
modules.imageAlt: Union Buildings in Pretoria

modules.title: Cullinan Diamond Mine
modules.summary: A guided tour of the Cullinan Diamond Mine, source of the largest gem-quality diamond ever found, with a look inside the historic mining town.
modules.imageAlt: Cullinan Diamond Mine near Centurion

modules.title: Match day at SuperSport Park
modules.summary: Cricket World Cup 2027 fixture day at SuperSport Park, known for its steep grass banks and fast, high-scoring pitch.
modules.imageAlt: SuperSport Park, Centurion, on match day

modules.title: Centurion at leisure
modules.summary: A free day for Centurion Mall or an optional excursion into Johannesburg for shopping and city sights.
modules.imageAlt: Centurion Lake in Gauteng, South Africa

modules.title: Arrive in Gqeberha
modules.summary: Land in the Windy City with a welcome stroll along Humewood Beach on Algoa Bay.
modules.imageAlt: Humewood Beach on Algoa Bay, Gqeberha

modules.title: Addo Elephant National Park
modules.summary: A full-day game drive in Addo Elephant National Park, home to over 600 elephants as well as lion, buffalo, and rhino.
modules.imageAlt: Elephants at Addo Elephant National Park

modules.title: City heritage & Donkin Reserve
modules.summary: St George's Park cricket heritage and museum, the Donkin Reserve, and the Route 67 public art trail telling the story of South Africa's democracy.
modules.imageAlt: Donkin Reserve in Gqeberha

modules.title: Match day at St George's Park
modules.summary: Cricket World Cup 2027 fixture day at St George's Park — the second-oldest Test ground in the world, first used in 1889.
modules.imageAlt: St George's Park, Gqeberha, on match day

modules.title: Gqeberha at leisure
modules.summary: A free beach day along Algoa Bay, with time for water sports or a relaxed boardwalk lunch.
modules.imageAlt: Humewood Beach on Algoa Bay, Gqeberha

modules.title: Arrive at the Lake Palace
modules.summary: A private boat carries you across Lake Pichola to the Taj Lake Palace — check-in, then watch the City Palace light up at sunset from the jetty.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Lake Palace floating on Lake Pichola, Udaipur

modules.title: City Palace & old town
modules.summary: Udaipur's City Palace complex, Jagdish Temple, and Bagore ki Haveli, ending with a traditional Rajasthani dance performance.
modules.imageAlt: City Palace complex in Udaipur

modules.title: Lake Pichola cruise
modules.summary: A boat cruise to Jagmandir Island, followed by the Saheliyon ki Bari gardens and a browse through Udaipur's miniature-painting studios.
modules.imageAlt: Boat on Lake Pichola near Jagmandir Island, Udaipur

modules.title: Monsoon Palace sunset
modules.summary: A short drive up to Sajjangarh, the Monsoon Palace, for sweeping sunset views over Udaipur's lakes and the Aravalli hills.
modules.imageAlt: Sajjangarh Monsoon Palace above Udaipur

modules.title: Udaipur at leisure
modules.summary: A free day for a spa treatment at the palace or optional shopping for Rajasthani miniature paintings and textiles.
modules.imageAlt: Boat on Lake Pichola near Jagmandir Island, Udaipur

modules.title: Arrive at the Rambagh Palace
modules.summary: Check into the Taj Rambagh Palace, once the residence of the Maharajas of Jaipur, with a garden stroll and a traditional Rajasthani thali dinner.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Rambagh Palace in Jaipur

modules.title: Amber Fort
modules.summary: A morning at Amber Fort with its Sheesh Mahal mirror palace, then Jaigarh Fort and a photo stop at the floating Jal Mahal.
modules.imageAlt: Amber Fort near Jaipur

modules.title: City Palace & Hawa Mahal
modules.summary: Jaipur's City Palace museum, the intricate facade of Hawa Mahal, the Jantar Mantar observatory, and bangle shopping in Johari Bazaar.
modules.imageAlt: Hawa Mahal, the Palace of Winds, in Jaipur

modules.title: Jaipur at leisure
modules.summary: A free day for a polo lesson or spa afternoon at the Rambagh Palace, or independent exploring of the Pink City bazaars.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Rambagh Palace in Jaipur

modules.title: Nahargarh Fort sunset
modules.summary: A sundowner at Nahargarh Fort, perched on the Aravalli ridge with the best panoramic views over the Pink City.
modules.imageAlt: Nahargarh Fort overlooking Jaipur at sunset

modules.title: Arrive at the Falaknuma Palace
modules.summary: Wind up the hill to the Taj Falaknuma Palace, former guesthouse of the Nizams, for a champagne welcome and sunset views over Hyderabad.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Falaknuma Palace overlooking Hyderabad

modules.title: Charminar & the Old City
modules.summary: Charminar, the Mecca Masjid, bangle and pearl shopping in Laad Bazaar, and the Nizams' Chowmahalla Palace.
modules.imageAlt: Charminar monument in Hyderabad

modules.title: Golconda Fort
modules.summary: Explore Golconda Fort, once the centre of the global diamond trade, then return for its atmospheric evening sound-and-light show.
modules.imageAlt: Golconda Fort in Hyderabad

modules.title: Hyderabad at leisure
modules.summary: A free day beside Hussain Sagar lake, with an optional excursion to Ramoji Film City.
modules.imageAlt: Hussain Sagar lake in Hyderabad

modules.title: Pearls & farewell high tea
modules.summary: A visit to Hyderabad's famed pearl bazaars at Pathergatti, followed by a farewell high tea on the Falaknuma Palace terrace.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Falaknuma Palace overlooking Hyderabad

modules.title: Arrive at the Taj Malabar
modules.summary: Check into the Taj Malabar on Willingdon Island, where the harbour meets the backwaters, with sunset views over passing ships.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Malabar hotel overlooking Kochi harbour

modules.title: Fort Kochi walking tour
modules.summary: The iconic Chinese fishing nets, Mattancherry Palace, the Paradesi Synagogue in Jew Town, and St Francis Church, one of the oldest European churches in India.
modules.imageAlt: Chinese fishing nets at Fort Kochi

modules.title: Kathakali & spice markets
modules.summary: An evening Kathakali dance performance with backstage make-up viewing, plus a walk through Kochi's historic spice markets.
modules.imageAlt: Kathakali dancer in traditional make-up, Kochi

modules.title: Kochi at leisure
modules.summary: A free day for an Ayurvedic spa treatment or independent exploring of Willingdon Island.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Malabar hotel overlooking Kochi harbour

modules.title: Marine Drive sunset
modules.summary: A stroll along Kochi's Marine Drive promenade and a short sunset cruise on the harbour before your road transfer onward.
modules.imageAlt: Marine Drive promenade in Kochi

modules.title: Board your houseboat
modules.summary: A road transfer from Kochi to Alleppey and a welcome coconut water as you board your private Kerala houseboat.
modules.imageAlt: Traditional houseboat on the Alleppey backwaters

modules.title: Backwater houseboat cruise
modules.summary: A full day cruising the palm-fringed canals and paddy fields of the Kerala backwaters, with a fresh Kerala lunch cooked on board.
modules.imageAlt: Traditional houseboat on the Alleppey backwaters

modules.title: Village life & canoe ride
modules.summary: A guided village walk with a toddy-tapping demonstration and coir-making visit, then a narrow canoe ride through channels too small for the houseboat.
modules.imageAlt: Narrow backwater canal near Alleppey

modules.title: Backwaters at leisure
modules.summary: A free day at a backwater resort — an Ayurvedic massage or simply hammock time on the water.
modules.imageAlt: Traditional houseboat on the Alleppey backwaters

modules.title: Alleppey Beach sunset
modules.summary: A sunset walk on Alleppey Beach beside its century-old pier, before transferring back toward Kochi.
modules.imageAlt: Alleppey Beach and pier at sunset

modules.title: Arrive at Fort Aguada
modules.summary: Check into the Taj Fort Aguada, built within a 16th-century Portuguese sea fort, with sunset over the Arabian Sea from the ramparts.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Fort Aguada on the Goa coastline

modules.title: Old Goa & Panaji
modules.summary: The UNESCO-listed Basilica of Bom Jesus and Sé Cathedral in Old Goa, then the Latin Quarter of Fontainhas in Panaji.
modules.imageAlt: Basilica of Bom Jesus in Old Goa

modules.title: Baga & Calangute beach day
modules.summary: A beach day at Baga and Calangute, with an optional dolphin-spotting boat trip and sunset at the Chapora Fort headland.
modules.imageAlt: Baga Beach in North Goa

modules.title: Goa at leisure
modules.summary: A free day at the resort — spa treatments, the pool, or an optional spice plantation tour inland.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Fort Aguada on the Goa coastline

modules.title: Market & farewell seafood
modules.summary: A browse through Mapusa Market for spices and cashews, followed by a farewell Goan seafood dinner.
modules.imageAlt: Mapusa Market stalls in Goa

modules.title: Road transfer to Agra
modules.summary: A comfortable road transfer from Delhi via the Yamuna Expressway, checking into a Taj-view hotel in time for your first glimpse of the monument.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Mahal at sunrise in Agra

modules.title: Sunrise at the Taj Mahal
modules.summary: A sunrise visit to the Taj Mahal itself, when the marble glows pink and gold and the crowds are thinnest, followed by Mehtab Bagh across the river for the classic reverse view.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Mahal at sunrise in Agra

modules.title: Agra Fort & Fatehpur Sikri
modules.summary: Agra Fort's red sandstone ramparts, then a day trip to Fatehpur Sikri, Emperor Akbar's abandoned Mughal capital.
modules.imageAlt: Agra Fort ramparts

modules.title: Agra at leisure
modules.summary: A relaxed morning with an optional visit to a marble inlay workshop, keeping alive the same pietra dura craft used on the Taj Mahal.
modules.imageAlt: Marble inlay artisan workshop in Agra

modules.title: Return road transfer to Delhi
modules.summary: A scenic road transfer back to Delhi along the Yamuna Expressway, with a stop at a roadside dhaba for a classic North Indian lunch.
modules.imageAlt: Taj Mahal at sunrise in Agra

modules.title: Speedboat to the Taj Exotica
modules.summary: A scenic speedboat transfer from Malé across the Emboodhoo Lagoon to the Taj Exotica Resort & Spa, checking into your overwater villa at sunset.
modules.imageAlt: Overwater villas at the Taj Exotica Resort, Maldives

modules.title: House reef snorkelling
modules.summary: A guided snorkelling session on the resort's house reef, followed by a glass-bottom boat tour of the Emboodhoo Lagoon's coral gardens.
modules.imageAlt: Snorkelling on the house reef in the Maldives

modules.title: Sandbank picnic & dolphin cruise
modules.summary: A private picnic on a sandbank in the middle of the lagoon, then a sunset cruise to spot spinner dolphins.
modules.imageAlt: Sandbank picnic setup in the Maldives

modules.title: Maldives at leisure
modules.summary: A free day for the overwater spa, the villa's private pool, or simply doing nothing at all above a turquoise lagoon.
modules.imageAlt: Overwater spa pavilion in the Maldives

modules.title: Farewell swim
modules.summary: One last swim in the lagoon before your speedboat transfer back to Malé for your onward Air India connection.
modules.imageAlt: Overwater villas at the Taj Exotica Resort, Maldives
